name: Veyra-NRVideo
description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.
one_liner: Windows software that uses AI to sharpen, denoise, and smooth out video in real time — from old footage to live game streams — so it looks like it was shot or rendered at much higher quality.
buyer: A content creator or streamer recording on a lower-end capture card or camera who wants their footage to look sharper and smoother on YouTube or Twitch without buying new hardware.
business_use_cases: A streamer runs it live on their capture feed so viewers see sharper, smoother gameplay video than their camera or card can natively deliver.
A video-restoration freelancer uses it to upscale and clean up old home videos or archival footage for paying clients.
A small video production shop offers 'AI footage enhancement' as an add-on service for clients whose raw source footage is low quality.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium presets tuned per game or capture device as an add-on pack
Offer a 'send us your footage' enhancement service for creators who don't want to run the GPU pipeline themselves

steal_this: Package three or four of the best-looking presets — streaming, old-video restoration, mobile footage — and sell them as a small add-on pack to the existing user base this weekend.
